name: air_separator
prompt:
Create one new inventory pixel-art machine sprite. Subject: A compact industrial AIR SEPARATION UNIT: two stout upright grey-green separation columns with rounded tops side by side, joined by a short upper cross-pipe, a clearly visible circular air intake fan in the broad lower front compressor plinth, small desaturated blue and sage outlet bands. Distinctive twin-column silhouette, not an oven or computer terminal. Tall columns fill both left and right upper quadrants; a solid machine enclosure connects the columns so there is no transparent middle hole.
Attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY; do not copy their silhouettes. Match their muted grey-green, dusty violet shadow, restrained cream highlights and broad contiguous pixel planes. View straight-on with slight visible top surfaces, very limited perspective. Native logical sprite is 48x48 pixels, entire object fits a roughly 44x44 square including dark one-pixel outline, strong readable silhouette at tiny size. All nine centres of the 3x3 inventory grid should land on opaque body: ensure broad body at upper-left, upper-middle, upper-right, middle and bottom. Render enlarged coarse pixel art with only 14-18 colours, no tiny dithering, no glossy gradients, no glowing neon, no labels, no text, no extra objects, no floor or cast shadow. Genuine transparent exterior background.
